netskope_new_alert_trigger.description: Runs when Netskope raises an alert, of any type or of the type chosen.

output.alert: The record returned by the service

parameters.description: Only alerts of this type. Leave empty for every type.
parameters.name: alert_type

netskope_new_anomaly_alert_trigger.description: Runs when Netskope sees unusual activity, such as a bulk download or a sign-in from an unusual place.

output.alert: The record returned by the service

netskope_new_audit_event_trigger.description: Runs when an admin changes something in the Netskope tenant, such as a policy or a setting, or signs in.

output.auditEvent: The record returned by the service

netskope_new_behavior_alert_trigger.description: Runs when user behavior analytics (UBA) flags a user's activity as risky.

output.alert: The record returned by the service

netskope_new_compromised_credential_aler.description: Runs when Netskope finds a user's credentials in a known breach.

output.alert: The record returned by the service

netskope_new_dlp_alert_trigger.description: Runs when a data loss prevention (DLP) policy flags sensitive data being shared, uploaded or sent.

output.alert: The record returned by the service

netskope_new_malicious_site_alert_trigge.description: Runs when a user visits, or is stopped from visiting, a known malicious site.

output.alert: The record returned by the service

netskope_new_malware_alert_trigger.description: Runs when Netskope detects malware in a download, upload or cloud app.

output.alert: The record returned by the service

netskope_new_policy_alert_trigger.description: Runs when a real-time protection policy blocks, alerts on or coaches a user's activity.

output.alert: The record returned by the service

netskope_url_list_changed_trigger.description: Runs when a URL list is created or its name or URLs change.

output.urlList: The record returned by the service
